end.summary:
Practised expanding base-10 numbers using place value and powers of 10.
Discussed zero as a placeholder in numbers such as 5,030 and 530.
Neel repeatedly identified that 5,030 has zero in the hundreds place.
The distinction between 5,030 and 530 remained unresolved; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value expansion with Neel, focusing on how zero holds an empty place. Neel used place names to explain that 5,030 has zero in the hundreds place, but they still mixed up a missing zero with an empty value, so this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, use place-value cards or a drawn chart for 5,030 and 530, and ask Neel to point to each place before reading the number.
